generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Annual Maintenance of Thirumenahalli Lake, Chokkanahalli Lake, Agrahara Lake, Palanahalli Lake & Kattigenahalli Lake

itemList.description: Clearing and grubbing road land including uprooting rank vegetation, grass, bushes, shrubs, saplings and trees girth up to 300 mm, removal of stumps of trees cut earlier and disposal of unserviceable materials and stacking of serviceable material to be used or auctioned, including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness as per directions of the Engineer Incharge with all lead & lifts (i) a- By Manual Means- In area of light jungle

Cutting and burning or disposing off Apu / Jondu from marshy areas as directed with all other ancillary operations complete with all lead & lifts as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of work.

Providing cleaning Labour for daily activities such as cleaning of debris/floating waste from silt traps, sweeping of pathway, watering of plantation, maintaining of garden/lake etc with all lead & lifts as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.

Providing Tractor-trolley for shifting of debris/silt/other materials including crew charges, operational & maintenance charges such as cost of fuel, lubricants etc with all lead & lifts as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of work

Providing Backhoe loader 1m3 capacity for Cleaning purpose including crew charges, operational & maintenance charges such as cost of fuel, lubricants etc with all lead & liftsas per the directions of the Engineer in charge of work
